LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather.label: <color=#79CBFF>Warp Feather Beckoning</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather.description: After a brief charge-up, a flash erupts beneath the caster and 84 to 128 <color=#79CBFF>Milira feathers</color> are generated instantly.\nAs for where the Milira feathers come from, Neiyu tends to mutter things about the manifestation of material laws and how feathers somehow cost five hundred thousand silver these days. It is hard not to laugh.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_ThunderMarkedStorm.label: <color=#8BD5FF>Thunderseal Domain</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_ThunderMarkedStorm.description: Marks all hostile targets in a radius of 3 cells. A few seconds later, each <color=#8BD5FF>marked target</color> suffers 3 to 5 heavy <color=#C7B8FF>lightning strikes</color> with additional <color=#79CBFF>EMP</color> damage.\n"One day I found a peculiar race. They were steeped in the aura of death, yet no less lively than the juniors who once cultivated life under me. Some old books said thunder subdues evil, or something like that, so I put this together."
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Bow_ArrowBarrage.label: <color=#79CBFF>Flowfeather Rend</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Bow_ArrowBarrage.description: Usable only while the <color=#79CBFF>bow form</color> is equipped. After charging for 5 seconds, 64 <color=#8BD5FF>flowfeather arrows</color> are unleashed along the target direction, covering the forward section of the battlefield.\n"I used to like playing a few games, you know//"
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_BlessingField.label: <color=#F39AD9>Flower Array: Prayer of Life</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_BlessingField.descriptio: Usable only in <color=#F39AD9>flower form</color>. Applies a group buff in the target area. Allies inside gain <color=#F39AD9>improved mood</color>, <color=#79CBFF>movement speed</color>, <color=#8BD5FF>reduced incoming damage</color>, and <color=#F39AD9>increased immunity gain</color>; injured parts are immediately restored to full.\n"Don't... I can't lose you..."
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_ToxinGarden.label: <color=#D786E8>Flower Array: Miasma Garden</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_ToxinGarden.description: Usable only in <color=#F39AD9>flower form</color>. Applies a hostile field over a large target area. Enemies inside are forced to suffer <color=#D786E8>severe food poisoning</color> and have a 10% chance to enter a <color=#F39AD9>berserk state</color>.\n"The way this actually works is that I stop time first, then feed each of them a spoonful of the porridge I made a few days ago. It's especially effective on ordinary Milira below the Qi-mark stage// Why would their anger have anything to do with me?"
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_Skyfall.label: <color=#8BD5FF>Sword Art: Skyfall</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_Skyfall.description: Usable only in <color=#8BD5FF>sword form</color>. The caster first ascends straight upward at high speed, then creates a landing warning in the target area before plunging down from above in a straight line, dealing heavy area damage and inflicting <color=#C7A2F8>vulnerability</color>.\n"They said I was fat// I said that was wrong// The real problem was that they even said... said that part of me was small... Alright then, eat this plunge!!!"
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_ExecuteHead.label: <color=#C7A2F8>Sword Art: Beheading</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_ExecuteHead.description: Usable only in <color=#8BD5FF>sword form</color>. After selecting a single target, the caster briefly retreats, then rushes forward at extreme speed and executes a <color=#F39AD9>beheading</color> near the target.\n"The one who taught me this was one of the few sword masters aboard the ship. She said that in the great chaos back then, only she and a few comrades still kept the habit of killing enemies by hand. She passed away only a few years after teaching me this move, so I still remember her words: 'Against an enemy, be steady, swift, precise, and ruthless.' I am dull-witted, so I only learned half of it."
